about: WILD LINK L4 (One World, the Woods zone thread, BUILD_PLAN phase 3, 2026-11-17): three plots of forest trail from the Clearing's Deep woods, west (its north side, seam ow_h_m17_1) west to Came A Lot's Fairy Forest (The Spring's east side, seam ow_v_m19_0). Its own room: the Clearing's room is full and its box would be 14 plots wide; two zones never join. The west end is the two-way link woods_camelot (its id kept; the Came A Lot zone thread puts its other end on The Spring's east side), so no seam door is written there.
